crying_in_the_walls.title: Crying in the Walls
crying_in_the_walls.description: You hear a child crying inside the walls. Soft, then louder. You search every room — empty. The crying continues. It seems to follow you.

outcomes.text: A radio, left on, looping a child's voice. You smash it.
An actual child, feral but alive. She watches you for hours before speaking.
Nothing. You search for hours. The crying never stops. You barely sleep.
You wake up exhausted, but alive. The crying has stopped.
You don't look back.

the_offer.title: An Offer
the_offer.description: A well-dressed man steps out from behind a car. Clean shave. Clean clothes. A clean smile. 'I represent a community,' he says. 'We have walls. We have food. We have rules. Come with me.'

outcomes.text: He's telling the truth. You spend a week in safety, leave with supplies.
It's a cult. You escape after three days. You smell like incense for weeks.
Cannibals. You barely escape. You learned what the 'rules' were.
He shrugs and walks away. 'Suit yourself.'
His smile flickers. He doesn't shrug.
He drops. You loot the body. A list of names. Your name isn't on it. Yet.

stranger_at_the_door.title: Stranger at the Door
stranger_at_the_door.description: Someone is knocking. Three times. Pause. Three times. They don't sound infected. They might be lying.

outcomes.text: You let them in.
They're alone, scared, helpful. They wait until you're ready.
They lie. Badly. You hear others whispering behind them. They leave.
They scream and bang on the door for an hour. Then silence. In the morning, claw marks.
They give up. You feel something — guilt? relief? You're not sure which.
They die outside. Their corpse attracts attention.

the_dog.title: The Dog
the_dog.description: A golden retriever trots up to you, tail wagging. It's wearing a tactical vest. There is a note pinned to the vest: 'HIS NAME IS BISCUIT. HE IS A GOOD BOY. PLEASE TAKE CARE OF HIM. HE HAS SEEN THINGS.'

outcomes.text: Biscuit licks your face. The world is briefly, briefly okay.

options.text: Take the vest, leave the dog

outcomes.text: Biscuit watches you walk away. You will think about this for the rest of your life.

wandering_trader.title: Wandering Trader
wandering_trader.description: An old man pulls a shopping cart full of junk. 'Trade?' he says. He shows you what he's got: bandages, ammo, a single mysterious can with no label.

options.text: Trade scrap for medical supplies (2 scrap)

outcomes.text: Fair deal.
Peaches. Real peaches.
Cat food. You eat it anyway.
Empty. You should have shaken it first.
He has nothing of value. You feel terrible.
He pulls a pistol. You weren't expecting that.
He nods and shuffles off into the dusk.

the_radio.title: A Voice on the Radio
the_radio.description: Static. Then a woman's voice: '...this is Site 3, broadcasting on all frequencies. The cure is real. We have it. We are at — ' Static. The location is gone.

outcomes.text: You find Site 3. It's a strip mall. The woman is dead. She was alone for a long time.
You can't pin it down. The trail goes cold.
You find a survivor camp. Real people. They've never heard of Site 3.
You wonder, sometimes, what was real.

the_horde_passes.title: The Horde Passes
the_horde_passes.description: You hear them first — like rain, then like thunder, then like the world ending. A horde is moving past your shelter. If you stay perfectly still, they might not notice.

outcomes.text: Hours of held breath. They pass. You are alive.
Someone in your group sneezes. Or coughs. Or breathes too loud.
You take down a few. The rest turn. All of them. Turn.
You make it. Just barely. You leave most of your supplies.
You don't make it.

found_a_kid.title: A Kid Alone
found_a_kid.description: A child, maybe nine, sits in the doorway of a burnt-out house. She doesn't cry. She doesn't speak. She just looks at you.

outcomes.text: She follows. She doesn't speak for weeks. Then one morning she asks if you have any books.
She's not what you thought she was.
You leave a bandage and some food. You hate yourself. You keep walking.
You don't look at her. You will, every night, for a long time.

infected_member.title: Infection
infected_member.description: {party_member} pulls down their sleeve. The bite is fresh. They look at you and don't say anything.

options.text: Use antibiotics if you have them

outcomes.text: It works. The bite scars but doesn't turn. Lucky.
It doesn't work. They turn that night. You knew it might not work.
It works. They survive without an arm. They never quite forgive you.
Too late. They turn. You shoot them.
They die from blood loss. You're a survivor, not a surgeon.
It's quick. They thank you, almost. The others watch.

options.text: Hide the bite, hope for the best

outcomes.text: They turn at night. They take someone with them.
Somehow — somehow — they don't turn. They are immune. You don't tell anyone what happened.

hidden_stash.title: Hidden Stash
hidden_stash.description: Behind a false wall, taped under a desk, in the freezer — someone hid this for the apocalypse, and never came back for it.

outcomes.text: Cans, water, a few bandages. Enough for a few days.
Weapons cache. Whoever lived here was paranoid. Justifiably.
Pre-collapse cash and gold coins. Useless. You leave them.
A diary. The last entry is two years old. The cause was never the dead. It was always us. You read all of it.

false_alarm.title: False Alarm
false_alarm.description: Something moves in the bushes. You raise your weapon. Heart pounding. You wait.

outcomes.text: A raccoon. A truly enormous raccoon. It hisses at you and waddles off.
It's a zombie. Just one. You handle it.
It's a person. They were as scared as you. You both laugh, awkwardly. They walk on.

settlement_argument.title: An Argument
settlement_argument.description: Two of your people are screaming at each other in the courtyard. It's about food rations. It's not really about food rations.

outcomes.text: You pick. The other festers.
You broker peace. They both respect you a little more.
Neither listens. Now they're both mad at you.
They shut up. Resentfully.
They don't. One of them leaves in the night. With supplies.

found_a_book.title: A Book
found_a_book.description: A paperback in surprisingly good condition. The cover is gone. You read the first page.

outcomes.text: A romance novel. You read it cover to cover by candlelight.
A survival manual. Genuinely useful.
A children's book. You weep, quietly, and don't know why.
A book on the apocalypse. Written before. They got most of it wrong.

the_offer_to_join.title: Lost Soul
the_offer_to_join.description: Someone walks toward you with hands raised. They look exhausted. 'Please,' they say. 'I just want to not be alone.'

outcomes.text: They join you. You'll see who they are over time.
Their answers feel honest. Probably.
They nod, defeated, and turn around.
They scream curses and storm off. You watch your back for days.

swarm_warning.title: The Wind Smells Wrong
swarm_warning.description: There is a smell on the wind. Sweet and rotten. Birds have stopped singing in the direction it comes from. Something is moving — something big — and it is moving toward you.

outcomes.text: You ready everything you can. The horizon stays empty. For now.
Some part of you knew, and chose not to.

rain.title: Rain
rain.description: It rains for the first time in weeks. Real rain. You stand in it.

outcomes.text: You stand in it.
Practical. You collect rainwater in cans.

fortify_drill.title: Drills
fortify_drill.description: You spend the day running drills. Everyone moves through the routines twice. The walls don't get any sturdier — but everyone's ready to use them.

outcomes.text: Everyone is sharper. For a few days.
There's always tomorrow.

scout_returns.title: The Scout Returns
scout_returns.description: Your scout comes back at dawn, hands shaking. 'I saw it. Coming this way. We've got time — but only if we use it.'

options.text: Reinforce — the boards, the doors, everything

outcomes.text: By dusk you've doubled the defenses against whatever comes next.
It'll have to be enough.

argument_at_dinner.title: Argument at Dinner
argument_at_dinner.description: Voices rise at dinner. Someone accuses someone else of stealing — quietly. The room goes still.

outcomes.text: You sort it out. A misunderstanding. Mostly.
There's no proof. The accusation lingers.
Everyone resents you a little. The room is colder for days.
The whisper grows.
